pg_greet.name: PoorGoat
pg_greet.text: Ser! Fresh catch? My bid is generous, my spread is modest.

pg_diamond.name: PoorGoat
pg_diamond.text: Diamond hands, that one. Holding a fish that long, I admire it.

pg_gas.name: PoorGoat
pg_gas.text: Gas fees on this pier are terrible, so I am only taking a tiny cut.

pg_sold.name: PoorGoat
pg_sold.text: Pleasure doing business. No rug pull, I promise.

pg_moon.name: PoorGoat
pg_moon.text: Between us, wen moon? When the fish prices go up.

pg_bye.name: PoorGoat
pg_bye.text: Hodl onto your hat out there, friend.

et_greet.name: Ethena
et_greet.text: Welcome in, ser. Rope, hooks, lamp oil, everything the sea throws at you.

et_spool.name: Ethena
et_spool.text: Fresh spool today. Strong enough for even the heaviest bags.

et_airdrop.name: Ethena
et_airdrop.text: An airdrop? No, but regulars do get a small discount.

et_buy.name: Ethena
et_buy.text: Good choice. That will serve you well.

et_degens.name: Ethena
et_degens.text: The sea is full of degens. Stay sensible and keep your powder dry.

et_bye.name: Ethena
et_bye.text: Come back soon, and do not panic sell your boat.

rd_launch.name: Captain Roid
rd_launch.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the biggest boat launch of the season!

rd_supply.name: Captain Roid
rd_supply.text: Limited supply! Only a few hulls left, ser. Wen buy? Now!

rd_rug.name: Captain Roid
rd_rug.text: Not a rug pull, I promise. It floats. Mostly.

rd_buy.name: Captain Roid
rd_buy.text: She is yours! Straight to the moon, or at least the next island.

rd_nomics.name: Captain Roid
rd_nomics.text: Early buyers get the best sea views. That is boat-nomics, baby.

rd_bye.name: Captain Roid
rd_bye.text: Fair winds, captain. Diamond hands on that wheel.

ag_desk.name: Roid and Co. agent
ag_desk.text: Roid and Company harbour desk. How can I help?

ag_menu.name: Roid and Co. agent
ag_menu.text: Boats, salvage, ferries. No gas fees, just friendly service.

ag_delivery.name: Roid and Co. agent
ag_delivery.text: Your delivery has arrived. Roid and Company thanks you.

ag_airdrop.name: Roid and Co. agent
ag_airdrop.text: Our airdrops arrive by boat, ser.

tv_stool.name: Tavern keeper
tv_stool.text: Pull up a stool, degen. What will it be?

tv_dice.name: Tavern keeper
tv_dice.text: Dice are on the bar, if you fancy losing it all.

tv_whale.name: Tavern keeper
tv_whale.text: Listen close. A whale has been spotted, and I do not mean the swimming kind.

tv_last.name: Tavern keeper
tv_last.text: Last call! Drink up, you lot!

tv_dip.name: Tavern keeper
tv_dip.text: Somebody bought the dip. Of the soup, I mean.

tv_mop.name: Tavern keeper
tv_mop.text: Another rug pull on the dance floor. Mop, please.

hl_state.name: Lieutenant Hale
hl_state.text: Lieutenant Hale, harbour watch. State your business, ser.

hl_weapons.name: Lieutenant Hale
hl_weapons.text: Keep your weapons sheathed in town, sailor.

hl_regs.name: Lieutenant Hale
hl_regs.text: The regulators are watching. Please act natural.

hl_quiet.name: Lieutenant Hale
hl_quiet.text: A quiet harbour. Long may it last.

hl_rug.name: Lieutenant Hale
hl_rug.text: Yes, I heard the one about the rug pull. The harbourmaster was not amused.

nv_heave.name: Navy officer
nv_heave.text: Heave to! This is the Navy! Prepare to be audited!

nv_colours.name: Navy officer
nv_colours.text: Ahoy there! Regulators off your starboard side! Show your colours!

nv_inspect.name: Navy officer
nv_inspect.text: Stand by to be inspected, ser!

nv_warn.name: Navy officer
nv_warn.text: Last warning! Heave to, or we fire!

nv_paper.name: Navy officer
nv_paper.text: Your paperwork, please! All of it!

pr_need.name: Press gang
pr_need.text: The navy needs sailors. You will do nicely.

pr_sign.name: Press gang
pr_sign.text: Sign here, or pay the fine. Your choice.

pr_stake.name: Press gang
pr_stake.text: Come along quietly. Welcome to the mandatory staking program.

ta_bread.name: Market seller
ta_bread.text: Fresh bread! Warm bread! No gas fees!

ta_orange.name: Market seller
ta_orange.text: Oranges! Sweet oranges, fresh from the airdrop!

ta_morning.name: Market seller
ta_morning.text: Good morning, ser! Lovely day for the harbour.

tb_moon.name: Townsperson
tb_moon.text: Wen moon? Tonight, if the clouds clear.

tb_rain.name: Townsperson
tb_rain.text: Rain again. My washing will never dry.

tb_boats.name: Townsperson
tb_boats.text: Look at the size of those boats!

tc_fish.name: Old fisher
tc_fish.text: Fish! Fresh fish, caught this morning!

tc_knees.name: Old fisher
tc_knees.text: This weather is murder on my knees, and on my nets.

tc_evening.name: Old fisher
tc_evening.text: Evening, traveller. Stay safe from the degens.

td_bear.name: Townsperson and crew
td_bear.text: Rain, rain, rain. I swear it follows me like a bear market.

td_boots.name: Townsperson and crew
td_boots.text: They say hodl. My boots say buy new boots.

td_airdrop.name: Townsperson and crew
td_airdrop.text: An airdrop! Oh. Just a gull. Never mind.

cw_cook.name: Townsperson and crew
cw_cook.text: Soup's on! Do not let it get cold, ser.

cw_lucky.name: Townsperson and crew
cw_lucky.text: Luck is with us today, skipper. I can feel an airdrop coming.

cw_lazy.name: Townsperson and crew
cw_lazy.text: Is it break time yet? I am in a long term holding pattern.

cw_brave.name: Townsperson and crew
cw_brave.text: Let them come. Diamond hands, skipper.

cw_drunkard.name: Crew
cw_drunkard.text: Who took my rum? Oh, here it is.

cw_sharpEyed.name: Crew
cw_sharpEyed.text: Something on the horizon. Could be a whale, could be trouble.

cw_seasick.name: Crew
cw_seasick.text: Please, no more waves. I am down bad.

po_over.name: Meridian police
po_over.text: Pull over! This is the police!

po_stop.name: Meridian police
po_stop.text: Stop the vehicle right now, ser!

po_arrest.name: Meridian police
po_arrest.text: You are under arrest. Step out slowly.

po_move.name: Meridian police
po_move.text: Move along, citizen. Nothing to see here.

po_rug.name: Meridian police
po_rug.text: Speeding, reckless driving, and, I suspect, a rug pull.

ra_clear.name: Tidewater radio
ra_clear.text: Clear skies and fair winds ahead. Looking bullish out there.

ra_squall.name: Tidewater radio
ra_squall.text: Squalls reported ahead. Secure your gear. Bearish conditions.

ra_storm.name: Tidewater radio
ra_storm.text: Storm warning. All vessels make for port. This is not a drill.
